site.about: Hey there! I’m Yogesh. I recently wrapped up my statutory audit articleship and am currently navigating the CA Final grind. During my articleship, I got to dive into the financials of a really fascinating mix of clients from Listed Investment bank (including its portfolio management and AIF sponsor segments), along with its Instiutional Stock Broking Subsidiary, to Upper-layer NBFC and manufacturing companies in the shipbuilding and solar energy sectors.
